title: 購物
description: 商店購物時常用的對話句型

sentences.en: Excuse me, I was wondering if you could help me find this shirt in a smaller size, because the one on the rack seems a bit too large for me.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我想請問你能不能幫我找一件小一號的這款襯衫，因為架上的對我來說似乎有點太大了。

sentences.en: I've been looking everywhere for a pair of running shoes that are both comfortable for daily use and sturdy enough for long-distance training.
sentences.zh: 我到處在找一雙跑步鞋，既適合日常穿著又足夠耐用來做長距離訓練。

sentences.en: Before I make a decision, could you tell me whether this product comes with a warranty, and if so, how long the coverage lasts?
sentences.zh: 在我做決定之前，能否告訴我這個產品是否有保固，如果有的話，保固期多長？

sentences.en: I noticed that this jacket is on sale today, but I'd like to know if there's any possibility of getting an additional discount if I buy two.
sentences.zh: 我注意到這件外套今天特價，但我想知道如果我買兩件是否有可能再多打折。

sentences.en: To be perfectly honest, I'm not entirely sure what I'm looking for, so I'd really appreciate it if you could recommend something based on my budget.
sentences.zh: 坦白說，我不太確定我在找什麼，所以如果你能根據我的預算推薦一些東西，我會非常感激。

sentences.en: The reason I'm returning this item is that when I got home and tried it on properly, I realized it didn't fit as well as it seemed to in the store.
sentences.zh: 我退這件商品的原因是，當我回家好好試穿後，發現它沒有在店裡看起來那麼合身。

sentences.en: I'd like to compare these two models side by side, because although the cheaper one looks similar, I want to make sure the quality is comparable.
sentences.zh: 我想把這兩個型號放在一起比較，因為雖然便宜的那款看起來差不多，但我想確認品質是否相當。

sentences.en: Could you check if this item is available in your other branch, since I've been to three stores already and nobody seems to have it in stock?
sentences.zh: 能否幫我查一下這個品項在你們其他分店是否有貨？因為我已經跑了三家店，似乎都沒有庫存。

sentences.en: I'm looking for a birthday gift for my mother, who is quite particular about quality, so I'd prefer something elegant and well-made rather than flashy.
sentences.zh: 我在找一份給我母親的生日禮物，她對品質很講究，所以我偏好優雅且做工精良的東西，而不是花俏的。

sentences.en: Since I'm buying this as a gift, would it be possible to have it wrapped in gift paper, and could you also include a small card with it?
sentences.zh: 因為這是要買來送禮的，可以幫我用禮物紙包裝嗎？另外能不能附上一張小卡片？

sentences.en: I've read several reviews online that say this brand tends to run small, so would you suggest I go up a size from what I normally wear?
sentences.zh: 我在網上看了幾篇評論說這個品牌偏小，所以你建議我買比平常穿的大一號嗎？

sentences.en: The last time I bought something from this store, the cashier mentioned there was a loyalty program, and I was wondering how I could sign up for it.
sentences.zh: 上次我在這家店買東西時，收銀員提到有會員計畫，我想知道我該怎麼註冊。

sentences.en: I appreciate you showing me all these options, but I think I need a bit more time to think it over before I commit to buying anything today.
sentences.zh: 感謝你給我看了這麼多選擇，但我想我需要多一點時間考慮，才能決定今天是否要買。

sentences.en: Would you happen to know when the next seasonal sale is, because I'd rather wait and get a better deal if it's coming up soon?
sentences.zh: 你知道下一次換季特賣是什麼時候嗎？因為如果快到了，我寧願等一等拿到更好的優惠。

sentences.en: I was initially planning to buy just one, but since there's a buy-two-get-one-free promotion, I might as well take advantage of it.
sentences.zh: 我原本只打算買一個，但既然有買二送一的活動，我不如好好利用這個優惠。

sentences.en: This is exactly what I've been searching for, and I can't believe I finally found it after looking in so many different stores over the past month.
sentences.zh: 這正是我一直在找的，我不敢相信在過去一個月逛了那麼多家店後終於找到了。

sentences.en: I'm a bit concerned about the return policy, so could you clarify whether I can get a full refund if the product doesn't meet my expectations?
sentences.zh: 我有點擔心退貨政策，所以能否幫我確認如果產品不符合我的期望，我能不能得到全額退款？

sentences.en: My friend recommended this store to me, saying that you carry a wide selection of organic products that are difficult to find anywhere else in the city.
sentences.zh: 我朋友推薦我來這家店，說你們有很多有機產品的選擇，在城市其他地方很難找到。

sentences.en: I was just browsing without any intention to buy, but this caught my eye immediately, and now I'm seriously considering getting it for myself.
sentences.zh: 我本來只是隨便看看沒打算買什麼，但這個立刻吸引了我的目光，現在我認真考慮要買來自用。

sentences.en: Do you offer any kind of installment plan for larger purchases, because I'd love to buy this sofa but I can't afford to pay the full amount at once.
sentences.zh: 大額消費有沒有提供分期付款方案？因為我很想買這張沙發，但無法一次付清全額。

sentences.en: I'd like to exchange this for a different color if possible, because the blue one I bought doesn't quite match the rest of my living room furniture.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的話，我想換一個不同的顏色，因為我買的藍色那個和客廳其他家具不太搭。

sentences.en: Having compared prices at several different stores, I have to say that this place offers the best value for money in terms of quality and selection.
sentences.zh: 在幾家不同的店比較過價格後，我必須說這個地方在品質和選擇方面提供最高的性價比。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if this is within my budget, but could you let me know if there are any upcoming promotions or coupons I could use to bring the price down?
sentences.zh: 我不確定這是否在我的預算內，但能告訴我有沒有即將推出的促銷活動或優惠券可以讓我把價格降低一些嗎？

sentences.en: The customer service here is always exceptional, which is the main reason I keep coming back even though there are cheaper alternatives elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 這裡的客戶服務總是很出色，這是我一直回來的主要原因，即使其他地方有更便宜的選擇。

sentences.en: I was told that if I spend over a certain amount, I'd qualify for free delivery, so could you tell me what the minimum spending threshold is?
sentences.zh: 我聽說如果消費超過一定金額就可以免運費，能告訴我最低消費門檻是多少嗎？

sentences.en: Although this brand is more expensive than what I usually buy, I've heard that the quality is significantly better and that the products last much longer.
sentences.zh: 雖然這個品牌比我平常買的貴，但我聽說品質明顯更好，產品也更耐用。

sentences.en: I purchased this online last week and chose in-store pickup, so I'm here to collect my order, which should be under the name Chen.
sentences.zh: 我上週在網上買了這個並選擇了到店取貨，所以我來取我的訂單，應該是在陳這個名字下面。

sentences.en: Would you mind measuring my feet properly, because I've noticed that my size varies quite a bit depending on the brand and style of shoe?
sentences.zh: 你能不能幫我好好量一下腳的尺寸？因為我注意到我的尺碼會因品牌和鞋型不同而有相當大的差異。

sentences.en: I'm trying to furnish my new apartment on a tight budget, so I'm specifically looking for items that are affordable but still decent in quality.
sentences.zh: 我正試著在有限的預算內佈置我的新公寓，所以我特別在找價格實惠但品質仍然不錯的物品。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your patience in helping me today — I know I've been indecisive, but I've finally made up my mind and I'll take this one.
sentences.zh: 非常感謝你今天耐心幫助我——我知道我一直猶豫不決，但我終於下定決心了，我要這個。
